capabilities: Read notes and PDFs aloud with sentence and word highlighting
Dictate English into the note via a double-tap shortcut or microphone button
Start text-to-speech from any sentence via right-click and control pause, skip and speed from a player bar
Install local speech engines, voices and dictation models by running setup commands in a terminal
Choose among 66 English voices from Kokoro and Piper
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Setup requires running terminal/PowerShell commands to install the speech engine and models; the plugin itself makes no network requests. English only and Obsidian desktop only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in text-to-speech or dictation, and typical TTS/STT tools send your text or voice to cloud services.

relations.evidence: 66 English voices, American and British, from Kokoro and Piper
66 English voices, American and British, from Kokoro and Piper

summary: On-device speech plugin that reads notes and PDFs aloud with word highlighting and dictates English text into Markdown notes.
